notifications.brand: Shenzhen Binsheng Technology Development Co Ltd
notifications.name: White Toothbrush Charger
notifications.danger: The plug does not contain any granular filler. Moreover, the fuse endcaps are also insecurely fixed, and the fuse is the wrong length. In the event of an electrical surge or fault, the plug may overheat and ignite, causing a fire. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.notifyingCountry: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

notifications.name: 60W Wood-Burning Pyrography Kit
notifications.danger: The product contains parts with poor-quality connections with wires soldered directly to the Printed Circuit Board. If the product is plugged into the mains power supply, the user could receive an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.name: Electric Rotating Display Stand
notifications.danger: The insulation can break down during normal use. If the user touches the metal part of the casing whilst the item is switched on and the insulation fails, the user could receive an electric shock.Moreover, the dimensions of the sleeved parts of the product plug's pins differed from the metal parts of the pins. This results in a distinct step between the two and may cause damage to the socket and undue wear and tear to the sleeve, leading to overheating with the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.name: Heated Jacket for Women
notifications.danger: The lithium-ion battery pack is poorly constructed and does not provide sufficient protection to prevent against thermal runaway, leading to the risk of fire. Additionally, the power supply plug pins are too close to the edge of the plug face, exposing the user to live parts, leading to electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.name: Kids' Led Light Up Toy Hair Braid, Birthday Party Flashing Hair Clip
notifications.danger: The battery compartment can easily be opened without use of any tools and the button cell batteries inside are easily accessible. Children may put them in the mouth and swallow them, causing damage to their gastrointestinal tract. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with European standard EN 62115.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 07/04/2025
